'''Minami Tsuda''' (Japanese: '''津田美波''' ''Tsuda Minami'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Tsuda was born on June 6, 1989 in {{wp|Kanagawa Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} and become a voice actress and singer as an adult. She began her work on {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|BW}}, where her main role was [[Iris's Axew]], though she also voiced various [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. Tsuda is currently affiliated with the talent group agency {{wp|Aoni Production}}.
